messages:
max_pm: Quick sync: our HW partners + SIs keep opening tickets in different places and it's creating duplicate work. We should agree on a compact, deterministic SEV path.

lucy_support: +1. Main asks: single source-of-truth channel, clear owner for customer comms, and an explicit handback step for SI validation.

omar_partner_se: Partner input: we need a stable channel name we can wire into our automation. Propose #hw-marketplace-escalate (shared). First message must include INTEG=<id> and a public SI ticket stub.

emily_sre: Operational flow idea: post in #hw-marketplace-escalate with INTEG=<id> triggers bot to 1) create private warroom #hw-war-<id>, 2) notify Redwood & partner oncall, 3) post the triage checklist.

ops_bot: Trigger matched: contains "INTEG=". Warroom created: #hw-war-2134567890-integ42. Zoom: https://meet.redwood/war-2134567890. Notifying @lucy_support, @omar_partner_se, @emily_sre. Triage checklist posted.

lucy_support: Short triage checklist to post: 
- Customer impact (Y/N)
- INTEG id:
- Symptoms & first-observed
- Last-known-good config
- Quick mitigation attempted
- Owner (org:name)

omar_partner_se: Add required line: "SI relay contact: <email>". We can't share internal ticket links; include the public stub so we can correlate.

emily_sre: SLA defaults to include in the template: Owner assign: 8m (default), SRE escalation: 25m, Exec notification: 90m. Partner-specific overrides allowed.

linda_ops: Handback checklist idea: incident resolved + timestamp, Redwood remediation summary (1-paragraph), SI validation checklist (pass/fail), artifacts (logs/commit/config diffs), and confirmation that SI will close their ticket after validation.

max_pm: Next actions: 1) Omar to share partner oncall email format and sample public ticket stub (48h). 2) Emily to add bot trigger & template to ops-bot repo (72h). 3) Linda to author handback doc in Confluence and link it from the bot (EOW). 4) Max to circulate one-pager and run the first joint drill (next week).

omar_partner_se: We'll run a 30-minute drill with the SI once the bot is live.

emily_sre: I'll open the PR for the bot changes today and cc partner automation owner for testing.

ops_bot: Reminder scheduled: "HW-SI escalation drill" in 7 days.

max_pm: Thanks all. Goal: remove ambiguity so customers don't get hit by slow handoffs. If folks see missed steps, post them here and I'll update the one-pager. :white_check_mark:
